source: Yahoo Finance chart API · ^IXIC 확정 일봉

quantile_table.basis: GBM daily 252d · 20,000 paths · seed 42 · asof close anchor; probabilities are model-conditional, not event probabilities
quantile_table.calendar: NYSE pre-registered fixed holiday rules; emergency closures corrected next refresh

path_realism.basis: same GBM draw as scenario paths; daily max drawdown; weekly sample paths
path_realism.selection_rule: within each scenario choose the unused actual path nearest terminal 25/50/75 percentile; ties use the lowest original path index

event_calendar_note: 2027 FOMC dates are Federal Reserve tentative dates. 2027 employment and NVIDIA earnings dates are omitted until officially published.

partition.S1: 연말까지 현재 cycle ATH 신규 돌파
partition.S2: ATH 미돌파 AND 연말 종가 > 2026-07-09 고정 기준가

note: 확정 일봉 252거래일의 수익률로 생성한 고정 seed GBM 조건부 분포. fat tail·정책 이벤트·실적 서프라이즈를 직접 모형화하지 않으며 질문별 physical_event 확률과 합산하지 않는다. 목표가·사건확률·투자자문이 아니다.

analog_risk_window.basis: selected-era median detrended residual; monthly phase resolution
selected-era median detrended residual; monthly phase resolution

calibration.target: S1 maximum drawdown over the full forecast horizon from origin
calibration.common_strength_approximation: calibrated to S1 over the origin window; interpretation depends on the current S1 weight of 65%
calibration.endpoint_rule: preserve each scenario's existing year-segment endpoints

selection_preregistration.standardization: pool-only z-score; current AI query excluded from fit
selection_preregistration.spacing: same-era neighbors must be at least 90 calendar days apart

selection_sensitivity.method: one-selected-era replaced by one non-selected candidate era
selection_sensitivity.depth_interpretation: native range varies by selected eras; every displayed alternative is recalibrated to the committed correction-depth base rate
selection_sensitivity.infeasible_policy: alternatives outside the strength bounds are disclosed and excluded from the depth invariance; any non-converged calibratable alternative, or fewer than 50% feasible alternatives, blocks publication

proximity_context.label: 무드리프트 기계적 기준
proximity_context.separation_rule: interpretation context only; never combine with physical_event forecast

physical_event.separation_rule: display in a separate box; never combine with scenario weights

reproducibility.distribution_source: existing scenario quantile_table and path partition

drift_sensitivity.use: reference_only; does not recompute scenario membership or probability

limitations: 선택 시대는 결과를 아는 소표본 역사 자료이며 독립 표본이 아니다.
경로의 굴곡은 월 단위 위험창이지 특정 거래일 사건 예측이 아니다.
조건부 분포의 확률·분위수와 physical_event 확률은 산술 결합하지 않는다.
AI 자본사이클 레짐은 coverage 게이트가 닫혀 있어 수치 입력에서 제외했다.
공용 strength는 현재 S1 비중에 의존하는 표시 근사이며 사건 발생확률이 아니다.
S1 종점은 trailing 252거래일 μ를 상속한 추세 지속 가정이다.
